items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: Yeah I knew them well. I knew them well. There was Johnny Christian and another one.

ctx.x: Do you remember um uh Nick LaRocca the original Dixieland band? Eddie Edwards and uh Emil Christian played with him for a while too different fellas. Nunez played with him for a while. Yellow Nunez played with Nick LaRocca. Do you remember hearing Nick LaRocca when you were playing? No. No. He was from uptown to the Irish Channel. Of course the Christian brothers were down here. Yeah the Christian brothers were down this way.
Yeah I knew them well. I knew them well. There was Johnny Christian and another one. Well I wasn't so much acquainted with the names but I know one was Johnny Christian.
Emil Christian is still living. Frank Christian was a carnet player too. Yeah. Emil still plays trombone and bass. Mm-hmm.
